decisions.reason: The resin injection unit uses the firm's core plural-component technology and in-house manufacturing, and it has been presented on its own page; with that investment and strategic fit, management will keep it.
This second injection unit belongs to the same committed product family as A, and its consistent standalone presentation signals continued commitment.
Automatic airless guns are central to the firm's spray-application identity and to its announced direction in application technology, so it will stay.
A manual airless gun is a staple accessory that supports equipment sales and spare-parts revenue, so dropping it is unlikely.
The air-assisted airless line has several models, which reflects heavy investment and visible commitment, and it fits the firm's innovation direction.

The data logger dropped from its own page to a mere mention, which suggests weaker results, but its fit with the firm's push into innovative application technology lets management blame slow digital adoption on temporary causes and persist.
